text:
Maya: Short sync on benchmark launch assets. Need final hero headline, two charts, and CTA routing. Can we lock now?

Ethan: Charts: (1) latency bands P50/P95 with a small P99 callout, (2) $/1k tokens by model with quantized vs baseline bars. Clean labels only.

Rina: Agree. For hero copy options: 'Predictable latency. Predictable cost.' or 'Fast inference, measurable savings.' Pick one.

Sam: I like the first one 1 it's clear. Also add a micro callout about batching: 'batching can cut steady-state cost ~40%'.

Pritam: Routing: three CTAs: Hosted trial (utm_campaign=bench_sm), Dedicated trial (utm_campaign=bench_mid), Contact sales (utm_campaign=bench_ent). Add hidden field 'use_case' on form.

Ethan: Quick data snippet for designers:
model,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_base,cost_quant
rw-3b,40,110,290,0.20,0.12
rw-34b,80,240,610,0.78,0.48
rw-70b,130,390,920,1.50,0.95

Rina: Hero should show relative bars, with a 'see numbers' link to an appendix slide that has absolute $ and ms.

AssetBot: Figma frames uploaded: https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-assets (marketing edit). Auto-generated alt text available.

Maya: Actions: Ethan -> PNGs and alt text by EOD; Rina -> headline finalization; Sam -> batching callout visual; Pritam -> create tracking links and tiny AB test flag. I'll assemble deck and circulate at 8am.

Sam: One quick UX ask 1 ensure buttons map to tailored landing pages so messaging aligns with CTA.

Maya: Agreed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
